item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 24/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will persistently bring generally fine weather to the coast of southern China in the next few days. Temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over inland areas. Under the influence of a replenishment of the monsoon, the weather will become cold over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of next week.

Date/Month: 25/12 (Sunday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Fine and dry.
Temp range: 15 - 19 C
R.H. range: 45 - 70 per Cent
PSR: Low
